notes.title: FIRST PATCH OF 2025!!
notes.content:
We finally have a patch!! This is just a bugfix patch to fix some issues I've had for a while. Not a content update, so just be mindful of that. So what changed?
-Starlings no longer stop spawning in Layer 3
-Bugfixes in the Volcano level (which will soon be revamped). Bucky no longer can get caught in spawn loop
-Duncan Dolphin has been rehomed.
-Minor environmental changes to Layer 0-4 (You may not notice that many of them)
-Fixed about as much Layer 4 pathing as I could for Blot (Keep me in the loop on that though since he's always given me issues)
-Minor construction

More content to be added soon! I've been wrapped up in development of our followup, HI-09, but more will be done soon enough!

Toodles! Thank you so much for the last year of support. You guys are all the best! :)

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content:
-Fixed a minor bug in Layer 2 where players could get stuck behind invisible collision 
-HEAVILY nerfed Layer 3 Plaza opening, allowing players to safely figure out most puzzles without being immediately swamped by enemies
-Buffed Layer 3 AI during the actual tasks you have to perform that don't involve puzzles (Batteries and turning on PCs)
-Removed Duncan Dolphin

The next update will be heavier in terms of actually changing the player experience and mass-fixing bugs, but I wanted to take baby steps since I only got back home a few days back. 

Toodle-oo!!
